growing.prompt: Hello. I have been growing. Barely.

options.label: You look good
options.reply: Thank you. I will process that slowly.

options.label: Just checking in
options.reply: I am still grass. This is reassuring.

pace.prompt: Everything seems to be moving quickly today.

options.label: Too quickly
options.reply: We can do one thing slowly.

options.label: I want to stop
options.reply: Stopping is allowed. Even plants have quiet seasons.

break.prompt: Do you need a small break?

options.label: Yes
options.reply: Then look away from the screen for a minute.

options.label: Not yet
options.reply: All right. I will wait here.
